claimed.title: PROPERTY TRANSFERRED
claimed.body:
You stepped forward.
The water took your name without asking.

Thank you for clearing the path.
The next specialist will find it easier.

— HOLLOW —

escaped.title: YOU LEFT SOMETHING BEHIND
escaped.body:
You turned away from the hole.
The front door still opened onto a porch.
Gravel. Trees. Cold air that did not smell like the house.

Behind you, the radio lists one fewer name.
You do not look back long enough to hear which.

— HOLLOW —

caught.title: THE HALLWAY AGAIN
caught.body:
You ran for the door without knowing enough.
The porch was gone. Only the hallway, waiting.

The house practiced your footsteps until they belonged to it.
Your name is already drying in the concrete.

— HOLLOW —
